text:
anya: heads-up: dashboard shows p99 < p50 for /v1/generate in eu-west on canary slice :thinking:
kevin: numbers?
anya: p50=112ms, p95=116ms, p99=81ms (canary-0.3)
morgan: that's a classic sign of mixed sample origins or unit mismatch
anya: ran a raw query and got origins: transport_time unit=ms, backend_latency unit=s
kevin: backend_latency in seconds got coerced to ms during rollup -> 0.081s became 81 and skewed tdigest merge
morgan: fix options: normalize units at ingest, or refuse to merge across differing unit tags and show provenance in UI
anya: product concern: PMs will think perf improved on canary. we need an explicit UI warning when pctl provenance contains multiple origins
kevin: plan: add unit-normalizer for latency metrics (s -> ms) in ingestion pipeline; add "unit_inferred" tag for legacy missing-unit sources (PR today)
morgan: and add a merge-blocker when unit tags conflict and a console badge that lists origins
metrics-bot: scan: found 2 recent slices with p99 < p50; posting details to #eng-platform-incidents
anya: thanks. i'll note this in the incident doc and mark as root cause pending the PR.
